name: fmright-explainer
description: Remotion source for the fMRIght scoring explainer (landing 16:9 + vertical 9:16).

scripts.vo:standin: uv run --no-project --with numpy --with piper-tts python scripts/vo.py standin --media "${EXPLAINER_MEDIA:-../../business/explainer}" && npm run data
scripts.vo:ingest: uv run --no-project --with numpy python scripts/vo.py ingest --media "${EXPLAINER_MEDIA:-../../business/explainer}" && npm run data
scripts.data: uv run --no-project --with faster-whisper --with numpy python scripts/build_data.py
